initial_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished landscape brand concept board for the existing open source project named exactly "mcp-ssh-rs". This is option 01 of three visual identity proposals, NOT a new product name. Project: SSH commands and binary file transfers for MCP/AI clients with optional human review. Design direction: warm, precise, approachable infrastructure; related to Waygate's ivory, dark ink, forest green and brass monoline identity, yet clearly its own symbol. Palette: ivory #F7F5F0, ink #23201B, copper #B66A45, forest #1E5F46. Logo: an original extremely simple open rectangular portal with a terminal chevron integrated into its structure, a tiny circular connection endpoint, rounded monoline strokes, strong silhouette at favicon size. No W, no shields, no padlocks, no anchor, no mascots. Wordmark exactly "mcp-ssh-rs", elegant lowercase humanist/geometric sans, typography direction Manrope with IBM Plex Mono for code. Make one cohesive beautifully art-directed board, 3:2 landscape high resolution, generous whitespace, precise editorial grid, flat vector-like graphics (a raster concept board), sharp text. Top small label "01 / WARM & PRECISE". Large hero logo+wordmark on ivory, small one-color version and inverse version on an ink tile, a visible favicon scale sample. Include typography specimen labeled "Manrope / IBM Plex Mono" with "SSH for agents" and small "ssh_exec  /  ssh_upload". Include four color swatches with the exact hex labels. Include a consistent six-icon family with rounded monoline strokes labeled "Hosts", "Commands", "Files", "Review", "Sessions", "History": server, terminal, file with arrow, approval decision, connected endpoints, record/clock. Bottom wide miniature README header application using the exact name, subtitle "SSH commands and file transfers for MCP clients", and a restrained connection line illustration. This is a brand presentation, not a fake working UI. No photography, no stationery, no 3D mockups, no excessive ornament, no invented product names. All spelling exact. Make the logo distinctive and the composition premium, calm and highly legible.
refinement_prompt: Edit this brand board only to correct its severe readability problem. Preserve option 1, its logo geometry, icon shapes, intended palette, typography direction, and overall section arrangement. Remove ALL dark cloudy overlays, haze, glows, gradients, spotlights, shadows, metallic effects and photographic lighting. This must be a perfectly FLAT digital graphic layout, NOT a photograph of a board. Make the entire main background a UNIFORM solid warm white #F7F5F0, ALL text and line icons crisp dark charcoal #23201B. Preserve small dark inverse-logo tiles with white marks. Every heading, icon and large wordmark must have strong readable contrast. Exact project name in EVERY location is "mcp-ssh-rs" with three lowercase groups and hyphens; fix any dots, spaces or erroneous letters. Remove all decorative marketing slogans, retaining only option label, project name, font family labels, section labels, palette hex labels, icon labels, and descriptive subtitle "SSH commands and file transfers for MCP clients". No new copy. The "one-color" logo sample must truly use one ink color. Render like a pristine flat SVG export, with opaque solid background, absolutely no illumination or shading effects anywhere.
